About WHITEROCK

Vietnam-based stone manufacturing for international buyers.

WHITEROCK COMPANY LIMITED produces marble, granite, quartz, and engineered stone products for distributors, contractors, builders, hospitality buyers, and custom projects.

Company

Built around product clarity, production control, and export support.

WHITEROCK's Vietnam factory leads production and export support, with OPTIMA STONE in Yunfu, China providing additional manufacturing capability for international buyers.

WHITEROCK supports buyers from sampling through packed shipment.

  • 15+ years production experience
  • Vietnam-based export manufacturing
  • Marble, granite, quartz, and engineered stone

Why Vietnam
